edges.reason: safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256,bytes) delegates all work to _safeTransferFrom.

transferFrom performs the state change by calling _transfer.

buyCryptoStars derives the token id from miner-influenced block values.
giftCryptoStars transfers each selected token through _transfer.

_transfer executes raw storage array length truncation and index rewriting.

giftCryptoStars mixes block.timestamp into the token id derivation.
block.timestamp is a miner-manipulable entropy source for the token id.

normalization_plan.reason: interfaceID is only consumed as the supportedInterfaces lookup key inside supportsInterface.
_tokenId is the sole token identifier used to rewrite owner, index and approval storage in _transfer.
_owner is the direct key into the token array read by balanceOf.
_index is only used to index into the owner's token array in tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
_approved is written straight into tokenApprovals by approve.
_operator is written straight into operatorApprovals by setApprovalForAll.
_from exists only to be compared with the resolved owner inside _safeTransferFrom.
_to is the recipient and callback target handled by _safeTransferFrom.
data is only forwarded to the receiver callback from _safeTransferFrom.
count bounds the paid distribution loop in buyCryptoStars.
friend is the fixed recipient of the internal giftCryptoStars distribution loop.
the local owner is resolved and used to locate the storage slot rewritten by _transfer.
indexToDelete is only computed and used to splice the owner array inside _transfer.
lastNft is only the copied tail element used by _transfer's array splice.
claimed is the loop counter controlling how many tokens buyCryptoStars distributes.
tokenid is the value produced by the timestamp/difficulty pseudo-random derivation.
codeSize is the extcodesize guard deciding the callback in _safeTransferFrom.
retval is the callback selector validated at the end of _safeTransferFrom.
